title: In situ homogenized fluorination strategy via active prelithiation enabling LiF solid electrolyte interphases for stable silicon anodes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE04689K, Paper
Yang Liu, Yi Sun, Shang Jiang, Shuo Li, Changming Qu, Daolin Deng, Bangkun Zou, Qian Hou, Xuyong Feng, Jiawei Wang, Hongfa Xiang
An in situ fluorination strategy is designed to pre-construct a stable LiF layer on the surface for achieving an ideal SEI.
